name: Angga Conni Saputra
headline: Policy-Tech Architect | Digital Transformation & Foresight | Cultural Data & Public Innovation
summary: Designing practical digital systems that connect policy intent, data, and human behaviour. Combines public-sector programme experience with AI-augmented development, low-cost serverless architecture, GIS, foresight, and stakeholder coordination to turn complex institutional challenges into usable tools and actionable evidence.

summaryFilters.description: Use tags, audiences, and themes to filter profile summaries in the future HTML interface.

summaries.title: Executive Profile
summaries.text: A policy and technology practitioner working across public-sector delivery, cultural heritage, public health, rural development, and education. Experienced in translating institutional mandates into practical workflows, structured data systems, capacity-building activities, and digital prototypes.

summaries.title: Policy-Tech Architecture
summaries.text: Designs low-cost, browser-based and serverless digital systems that connect institutional workflows, structured data, reporting, and decision support. Focuses on practical adoption, auditability, maintainability, and implementation under resource constraints.

summaries.title: Foresight & Strategic Intelligence
summaries.text: Builds horizon-scanning workflows and AI-assisted radar tools to discover emerging signals, organise evidence, map relationships, and support anticipatory policy thinking. Facilitates workshops that turn observations from communities and practitioners into potential innovation pathways.

summaries.title: Cultural Heritage & Cultural Data Science
summaries.text: Combines experience supporting UNESCO's 2003 Intangible Cultural Heritage and 2001 Underwater Cultural Heritage conventions with digital mapping, heritage knowledge products, stakeholder coordination, and experimental tools for documenting and safeguarding living heritage.

summaries.title: Behavioural Science for Policy Delivery
summaries.text: Uses behavioural framing, peer influence, local ownership, and practical workflow design to address the gap between formal programme outputs and real-world adoption. Experience includes supporting digital-reporting uptake in remote health districts and applying stakeholder-sensitive approaches in multilateral settings.

summaries.title: Data Governance, Analytics & Evidence
summaries.text: Experience ranges from national data collection guidelines and metadata standards to policy briefs, dashboard oversight, qualitative analysis, anomaly-detection prototypes, and operational data quality improvements. Emphasises traceable evidence and the policy implications of data, not only visualisation.

summaries.title: Coastal Resilience, Ocean Literacy & Citizen Science
summaries.text: Develops and supports digital tools and learning pilots that help students and communities map coastal environments, monitor mangrove ecosystems, and connect environmental education with field evidence and local resilience priorities.

summaries.title: AI-Augmented Digital Product Development
summaries.text: Uses AI-augmented development to prototype and deliver browser-based tools across policy, education, GIS, document processing, and public-sector workflows. Favors accessible technologies and transparent architectures that can be maintained without expensive infrastructure.

summaries.title: Capacity Building & Learning Design
summaries.text: Supports capacity development through learning-needs analysis, training materials, digital learning experiences, workshops, and practical tools. Experience spans cultural heritage reporting, health logistics, digital-government systems, and school-based environmental learning.

summaries.title: Multilateral Coordination & Stakeholder Diplomacy
summaries.text: Experience coordinating government, UN, academic, NGO, and community stakeholders; supporting regional workshops and delegations; facilitating cross-institutional cooperation; and analysing political-economy and stakeholder risks in culturally sensitive policy environments.

summaries.title: Rural Development & Local Economic Systems
summaries.text: Worked with national village-development data and policy processes, including innovation documentation, Village-Owned Enterprises, national research coordination, and analysis of unintended local economic consequences of infrastructure investments.

summaries.title: Knowledge Products, Publications & Communication
summaries.text: Produces policy briefs, books, training materials, reporting guidance, multimedia documentation, and publication layouts. Authored and edited rural-development knowledge products and published The Invisible Architecture of Diplomacy in 2026.
